title: Costume Design
description: CUSTOME DESIGN can play a vital role in defining the nature of a character as well as add to the realism of the action. Having a trilogy also gave the costumers a chance to show character development. Luke, for example, goes from rough-hewn farm togs in STAR WARS to an austere and somewhat mystical all-black look as a Jedi Knight in RETURN OF THE JEDI. Sketches by Nilo Rodis-Jamero based on concepts by him and Aggie Guerard Rodgers.
